Well, my partner and I found a way to cleanse and rebuild these so we can use them again. I find damaged ones and take them apart to salvage what we can to make refirbished ones. Actually, I have some parts piling up here that I need to get to her. 

Interested in helping me out? You'll just need to run some parts to her down the path here.

We've got some glint we can give ya for your time.
